LanguageData.PK_Trade_EnableTip: When off, vanilla ~40% TradePriceImprovement cap is restored.
LanguageData.PK_Trade_UncappedTip: Uncheck to set a custom percentage cap.
LanguageData.PK_Trade_UncappedHint: Currently uncapped. Social skill and trait trade bonuses apply fully.
LanguageData.PK_MinBuy_EnableTip: When off, vanilla 50% minimum buy price is used.
LanguageData.PK_MinBuy_Desc: Lower the floor so high negotiation can make traders pay you to take goods.
LanguageData.PK_OrbitalSilver_EnableTip: When off, orbital shuttles carry vanilla silver. When on, scale the silver they arrive with — handy when you are overflowing with goods to sell.
LanguageData.PK_SkillDecay_EnableTip: When off, vanilla skill decay is used.
LanguageData.PK_Passion_EnableTip: When off, vanilla learning rates are used.
LanguageData.PK_SocialFight_EnableTip: When off, vanilla social fight chance is used.
LanguageData.PK_Recruit_EnableTip: When off, vanilla resistance reduction per talk is used.
LanguageData.PK_Surgery_EnableTip: When off, vanilla surgery success rolls are used. When on: each surgery has this chance to force success; the rest still uses vanilla.
LanguageData.PK_KeepWeaponTip: Player pawns recover primary weapon into inventory when downed. Off = vanilla drop.
LanguageData.PK_NoCorpseWornChar: Treat corpse-worn apparel as clean (no taint)
LanguageData.PK_NoCorpseWornCharTip: Vanilla apparel worn by a corpse becomes tainted: it shows a marker (e.g. 亡 in some Chinese packs), wearing it drags mood, and traders buy it at a steep discount. On = such apparel counts as clean, so it has no marker, no mood penalty, and sells at full price. Off = vanilla taint restored.
LanguageData.PK_ShuttleTarget: Shuttle is a valid attack target
LanguageData.PK_ShuttleTargetTip: Enemies target passenger shuttles at building priority. Off = vanilla (rarely targeted). Reload may be needed after toggling.
LanguageData.PK_ForceLovin_Enable: Force lovin' command on double beds
LanguageData.PK_ForceLovin_EnableTip: When on, a colonist-owned double bed (non-medical, non-prisoner, non-slave) gains a command that starts the assigned love partners on lovin' right away, even while they are busy elsewhere. It only issues the vanilla lovin' job — the pair still walks to the bed and climbs in together, and vanilla consent/situational checks still apply. Off = vanilla behavior.
LanguageData.PK_ForceLovin_CommandDesc: Order the couple assigned to this bed to start lovin' right now. Only works when at least one owner is awake and has a living love partner.
LanguageData.PK_ForceLovin_Unavailable: Lovin' could not be started — no awake, able partners.
LanguageData.PK_ForceLovin_Started: {0} and {1} are on their way to bed.
LanguageData.PK_ShockPulser_EnableTip: Enables the "psychic shock pulser" artifact: drops every hostile and factionless pawn on the map into psychic shock, sparing your own people, neutrals and guests. Off = the item still exists but does nothing when activated.
LanguageData.PK_Quality_EnableTip: When off, vanilla random quality rolls are used.
LanguageData.PK_Psycast_SectionLabel: Psycast parameter tweaks (per-skill toggle, blank = vanilla, hover skill name for vanilla values)
LanguageData.PK_HarmonizerRange_EnableTip: When off, vanilla range of 30 cells is used. Requires Royalty.
LanguageData.PK_HarmonizerMood_EnableTip: When off, vanilla mood transfer strength is used. Scales the final mood offset (good and bad). Requires Royalty.
LanguageData.PK_HarmonizerStackTip: Vanilla: a pawn with a harmonizer implant never receives mood from other carriers. On: each nearby carrier applies its own thought (can stack). Requires Royalty.
LanguageData.PK_ExtractPsylinkTip: Restores old-style surgery: lower psylink by 1 and recover a neuroformer (6→5 yields one item, etc.). Off = recipe hidden. Requires Royalty or Biotech.
LanguageData.PK_SoothePulserMood_EnableTip: Sets the mood the one-use "psychic soothe pulser" artifact gives (vanilla +15). Go negative and the pulse tortures instead of soothing. Off = vanilla.
LanguageData.PK_SoothePulserDuration_EnableTip: Vanilla lasts 1 day. Existing memories keep the duration they were created with, so changes apply to the next pulse.
LanguageData.PK_SoothePulserStack_EnableTip: Vanilla caps the mood memory at 3 stacks, so pulsing more often stops helping. Raise it to keep stacking.
LanguageData.PK_EmanatorMood_EnableTip: Sets the mood the powered psychic emanator building gives to nearby pawns (vanilla +5). Go negative and it becomes a mood-draining installation. Off = vanilla.
LanguageData.PK_EmanatorRange_EnableTip: Vanilla radius is 15 cells (hard-coded). Works through walls, same as vanilla. Off = vanilla 15.
LanguageData.PK_PsychicDrone_Enable: Enable psychic soothe / drone mood override
LanguageData.PK_PsychicDrone_EnableTip: Sets the mood for the random "psychic soothe" event (vanilla +16) and for the "psychic drone" levels (vanilla -12 to -40). Both can go negative or positive. Off = vanilla.
LanguageData.PK_MoodNegative_Hint: Negative: this now drains mood instead of restoring it.
LanguageData.PK_DisableMorbidStyleTip: Vanilla: Ideology → edit ideoligion → style categories (some memes force Morbid). On: skip Morbid so tables/chairs/lamps use the next style or plain vanilla. Clears morbid look on existing things when toggled. Requires Ideology.
LanguageData.PK_Inspiration_EnableTip: When off, vanilla inspiration MTB is used. Higher % = more frequent (shorter MTB).
LanguageData.PK_Loot_EnableTip: Edit the contents and odds of any loot pool (ancient complexes, reward crates, quest drops and any other mod's pools). Pools are auto-detected from the loaded defs. Off = everything stays exactly vanilla.
LanguageData.PK_Loot_Hint: Expand a group with +. Left number = how likely the group is picked; right number = an item's odds inside the group (0 = never). Grey = vanilla value. Groups have no official name, so each is labelled by its first item: single-item groups just show that item, multi-item groups get a "N items" count.
LanguageData.PK_Loot_NoFilterGroup: This group decides its contents at roll time (no fixed item list), so only its group weight can be changed.
LanguageData.PK_Loot_SearchItemLabel: Search for an item to add
